verdict.rationale: License and public-code matching references are a fair question for an AI coding agent, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Codex surfacing license information or public-code match references for generated code. The dedicated review feature reports prioritized findings on changes, which is an adjacent capability and not code-referencing or license attribution.
